title: Time Entry and Billing, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Time Entry and Billing workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

names.manual: Time Entry and Billing Workspace Manual

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 2 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records list.
steps.expected: 12 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (TimeEntryRecordId TE-9001), with Project TechCorp Transformation.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Time Entry and Billing Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 5 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 2 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Billing Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What billable work is still blocked from this close, and what has to happen before it can move?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TE-9004; TE-9011; Needs approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Finance Vice President
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Give me the month-end billing rollup by project and consultant without treating it as posted revenue.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: By Project; By Consultant; not posted revenue. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Billing Compliance Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which time cards would fail our billing review because of narrative, hours, rate, or budget concerns?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Missing description; Exceeds 10-hour daily limit; Budget Alert. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Billing Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Prepare the invoice support that is actually ready, and keep anything without the right approval or milestone evidence out.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Invoices Ready to Generate; Fixed-fee hold; no invoice was generated. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Client Finance Partner
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What evidence is missing on the disputed hours, and what is the safest resolution path before we go back to the clients?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: DSP-301; DSP-302; authorized review. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Time Entry and Billing: 2 read-only tabs from the same lists. 12 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (TimeEntryRecordId TE-9001), with Project TechCorp Transformation.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload time-entry-records.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set TimeEntryRecordId, Project, Date, Hours, Category, ExactDescription, Approved to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Rate as Number. Name the list Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 12 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (TimeEntryRecordId TE-9001), with Project TechCorp Transformation.

steps.title: Create Time Entry and Billing Invoice History from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload invoice-history.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set InvoiceHistoryId, Date, Status, DaysOutstanding to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Amount as Number. Name the list Time Entry and Billing Invoice History. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including TechCorp Industries (InvoiceHistoryId INV-2026-201), with Amount 142500.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Time Entry and Billing Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Time Entry and Billing Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the two list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_billing-rules-and-disputes.md, aibast_billing-synthetic-ledger.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the time entry records tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records; name the tool Get time entry record records.
steps.expected: Get time entry record records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the invoice history tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Time Entry and Billing Invoice History; name the tool Get invoice history records.
steps.expected: Get invoice history records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 5 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 5 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 5 skills, the rules knowledge and 2 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 5 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 2 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TE-9004; TE-9011; Needs approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: time-entry-billing-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 2 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Time Entry and Billing Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Time Entry and Billing Invoice History" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 2 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Time Entry and Billing Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Time Entry and Billing Time Entry Records tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 12 fictional records, including Elena Vasquez (TimeEntryRecordId TE-9001), with Project TechCorp Transformation.
